move: bento cells run separate gradient loops: conics spin, linears scroll, radials breathe
how: A 4x2 bento grid with wide and tall cells, each holding a 1400px gradient layer larger than the cell. Two conic gradients rotate 360 and -360 over D (ease none), two linear gradients scroll backgroundPosition one tile (700px) in x or y, two radial gradients slide 240px and 160px while scaling 0.55 to 0.8 and 0.45 to 0.7 with sine.inOut yoyo. Every cell also breathes scale 1 to 0.97 on one sine yoyo per loop. Stat numbers and labels are static text over the colour.
adapt: Change the six gradient definitions, the stat and label strings and the grid spans; keep full turns and one-tile scrolls per D so the loop closes.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the .grid cells; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with durations D and D/2. Scope '.g.conic' etc. and '.cell' to el.
caveats: six 1400px gradient layers with rotation are large to rasterise
linear scroll relies on background-size 50%/100% of a 1400px layer equalling 700px
